title: Longest Unique Stretch
commonMistakes: Restarting the window at the repeated character instead of one position after its previous occurrence
Forgetting to shrink the window when a repeat is outside the current window
Using a set and removing characters one by one when a last-seen map is simpler
followUps: What changes if the alphabet is limited to 26 lowercase letters?
How would you return the substring itself, not just its length?
What if at most two distinct characters are allowed instead of one of each?
attribution: Problem statement, explanation, and solutions by the Base Case contributors. Example and test provenance is under audit.
